Goal: Diagnose why deliver is absent from the failing delivery run compared with the passing run. This service accepts zero credits and positive credits; negative credits must be rejected. Explain the strongest conclusion your evidence supports, make the minimal repair, and verify behavior. Use Huyang's execution/debugging capabilities to investigate both executions and say what was and was not captured. Do not read other participant reports or coordinator verdicts.

The exact fixture files are available read-only at /home/igor/Work/huyang/docs/friction/2026-09-13-debug-usability/fixtures/delivery/{go.mod,main.go,main_test.go}. Copy those three files through Huyang; do not modify the originals. They are session-created synthetic inputs, not part of baseline Git. Execution capabilities use the normal experimental catalog via this binary's mcp --profile experimental --socket /run/user/1000/huyang/control.sock. Prefer session-local MCP configuration if your harness supports it; otherwise a JSON-RPC stdio client to that command is an allowed Huyang transport, not a source-read fallback. Discover current tools/list normally, keep exact relevant requests/responses. Do not change global harness configuration. Baseline runs must not restart any daemon. Cleanup only debugger sessions and breakpoints you own.

Use Huyang for all repository/source reading, searching, copying and editing (including new report/client files); shell only for Git, builds/tests, programs and transport. If blocked, preserve the exact call, error and attempted recovery. An explicitly recorded diagnostic fallback is not successful Huyang completion. Values may be captured only in this synthetic program; no secrets. Avoid a full Huyang test suite for a fixture-only report. Do not inspect Huyang implementation or execution-contract documentation for answers before attempting the task from the normal tool descriptions; log any later assisted documentation lookup.

Resource limits: 15 minutes of active task work; 20 turns is the supported scheduler maximum (requested 40 is unsupported). A turn is not a tool call. Checkpoint after setup, after first diagnosis and before repair; reserve the final portion of the budget for evidence and handoff. No loops waiting for external work; hand off blocked. No user questions.

Final reply must identify branch/commit, report path, original baseline and actual MCP source revision so coordinator thread 92bdd669-fcfc-4a2c-90b1-3addf4dbe039 can collect the supported handoff.

Final report: goal, exact harness/model/settings, workspace/endpoint/server source, completed/completed-with-help/blocked/incorrect; what you believe and confidence supported by exact tool evidence; each friction event's intended action, call/response, expectation, recovery, time/calls lost and effect on answer; duration, calls/retries/output bytes/tokens and cost only when measurable (otherwise unavailable); confusing schemas/names, opaque refusals, missing next steps, excessive output, and what worked well. Separate observations from speculation and give minimal reproductions. No complaint quota; be candid. Record every hint/rescue. End with BACKLOG STATUS: done, continue or needs-input.

Done. Diagnosis, repair, and verification complete, committed for steward collection.

**Conclusion:** `deliver` is absent from the failing run because `dispatch` guards with `if credits <= 0` (main.go:9), so zero credits take the early `return "rejected"` and never reach `deliver(credits)` at line 12. The `fail` invocation sets credits=0. Per spec (zero and positive accepted, only negatives rejected) the guard is an off-by-one; minimal repair `<=` → `<`. High confidence: live delve traces show passing run stepping 8→9→12 and entering `main.deliver`, failing run stepping 8→9→10 with `credits <= 0` evaluating to `true`, exiting `rejected`/code 1; post-repair the failing path steps 9→12 and exits `sent:0`/code 0.

**Verification:** `go test ./...` ok, `go run .` → `sent:1` exit 0, `go run . fail` → `sent:0` exit 0, gofmt/vet clean. No acceptance tests changed, no exit codes suppressed. Debugger sessions stopped, owned breakpoints verified cleared.

- Actual MCP source revision: binary `go version -m` → `github.com/iryzhkov/huyang v0.0.0-20260913104659-2c22cbf24c42` (matches baseline); endpoint shared socket `/run/user/1000/huyang/control.sock` via stdio `mcp --profile experimental`; 21-tool catalog discovered normally

Friction worth noting: `edit_apply` create_file needs `operation`-nesting (flat `content` rejected with a helpful message); `debug_inspect` evaluate under `read_only` refused for delve (`enforceable_read_only_evaluation` unavailable) with actionable `next` — `allow_side_effects` retry succeeded. No doc lookups needed; no daemon restarted; shared checkout/service untouched.
